svg.title: Principal role Scope authorization model
svg.desc: Actors and Business Groups are security principals. Direct memberships connect Actors to Project Groups. Immutable Role Definition versions contain product Permissions, and each Role Assignment binds one principal and one role version to one Authorization Scope. Authorization decisions combine applicable assignments and retain a separate business-gate result.
